goal.en: Press the nib flat and slide it one nib-width to make a diamond. Stack five from the top: that is the height of a Naskh alif.
Start high and move down with one steady movement.
Move from right to left, keeping the curve unhurried.
Let the curve descend, turn, and rise without retracing.
A Naskh alif stands five nuqtas tall. Keep it upright and steady, with a slight lean. Follow this draft model.
Write the body first, then add its compact dot below.
Complete the bowl, lift your pen, and place the dot.
Bring the tall stroke into a rounded returning curve.
Keep the connection continuous. Add the two dots after the body.
Follow the initial form of ba, then place its dot. This is one component, not the whole word.
